turns.question: For outreach messages sent between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that got a reply, what was the 75th percentile of hours between the message and the reply?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the time between an outreach message and its reply, so I cannot give a 75th percentile of reply hours. The closest metrics are Messages replied (count of outreach messages that got a reply, by the day sent) and Reply rate (share of outreach messages that got a reply, by the day sent); I did not run a query, so there is no freshness statement to quote.
